claims.statement: The anchor tenant at Northgate Business Park holds two successive five-year renewal options.

citations.quote: Tenant holds two successive five-year renewal options, exercisable at 95% of then-prevailing fair market rent, conditioned on twelve months' prior written notice and tenant not being in monetary default at the time of exercise.
